frac_per_mg_note: ASSUMPTION, not calibrated; all MG results scale with it
parameterisation: reproductive thresholds scaled away from emergence, so stage INTERVALS stretch; an earlier version added a constant offset, which shifted the sequence without lengthening seed fill and voided the exercise
ensemble: ensemble-median CMIP6 delta; spread not propagated here
model: yield_anom ~ season_gdd + season_edd + win_prcp_mm + I(win_prcp_mm**2) + C(fips5)
not_identified: predicted yield is linear in maturity group because season_gdd is identified from seasons varying at one maturity group; no optimum is reported
needs: a crop model carrying yield potential, per Peng et al. 2020
